title: Shesha-khanda, part 7 (portion 52)
html:
The section "The Final Pastimes": the poor brahmana from Dravida and Vibhishana — the end of the text in Bhaktisiddhanta's edition. Chapter 4 (only in the 1983 edition): the concealment of the Lord — He enters into Jagannatha; the devotees' grief; Lochana Dasa's closing word about himself

The Final Pastimes (Shesha-lila)

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. Shortly before Sriman Mahaprabhu withdrew [from mundane sight], a poor brahmana from Dravida, tormented by want, came to Purushottama and fasted seven days to obtain the mercy of Sri Jagannatha-deva; not obtaining it, he resolved to give up his life in the ocean. Then, on the ocean shore, by providence he met Vibhishana, and Vibhishana, instructing him: "A living being experiences joy and sorrow according to the fruits of his karma; therefore one should worship Jagannatha-deva, remaining indifferent to joy and sorrow," went on his way; but the brahmana did not leave him and together with Vibhishana came to Sriman Mahaprabhu. [Mahaprabhu, having granted him wealth through Vibhishana,] instructed him in [the service of] Krishna and showed him mercy.

Raga varadi

আর অপরূপ কথা কহিব এখন ।
গৌরচন্দ্র-গুণগাথা নিত্যই নূতন ॥ ১ ॥

āra aparūpa kathā kahiba ekhana |
gauracandra-guṇagāthā nityai nūtana || 1 ||

ara aparupa katha — another wondrous account; kahiba ekhana — I shall tell now; gaurachandra-guna-gatha — the tale of Gaurachandra's glories; nityai nutana — is ever new

1I shall now tell another wondrous account:
the tale of Gaurachandra's glories is ever new1.

কহিব নিগূঢ় কথা শুন একচিত্তে ।
অধম জনের মনে না হয় প্রতীতে ॥ ২ ॥

kahiba nigūṛha kathā śuna ekacitte |
adhama janera mane nā haẏa pratīte || 2 ||

kahiba nigudha katha — I shall tell a hidden account; shuna ekachitte — listen with one mind; adhama janera mane — in the minds of low people; na haya pratite — there is no belief

2I shall tell something hidden — listen with one mind:
in the minds of low people there is no belief [in it],

বৈষ্ণবজনের মনে পরম উল্লাস ।
পরম নিগূঢ় গৌরচন্দ্রের প্রকাশ ॥ ৩ ॥

baiṣṇabajanera mane parama ullāsa |
parama nigūṛha gauracandrera prakāśa || 3 ||

vaishnava-janera mane — in the hearts of Vaishnavas; parama ullasa — supreme joy; parama nigudha — most hidden; gaurachandrera prakasha — the manifestation of Gaurachandra

3but in the hearts of Vaishnavas — supreme joy:
it is a most hidden manifestation of Gaurachandra.

দ্রাবিড়ে ব্রাহ্মণ এক আছে রাম নাম ।
পরম দুঃখিত—অঙ্গে অস্থি আর চাম ॥ ৪ ॥

drābiṛe brāhmaṇa eka āche rāma nāma |
parama duḥkhita—aṅge asthi āra cāma || 4 ||

dravide brahmana eka — in Dravida a brahmana; achhe rama nama — named Rama; parama duhkhita — utterly wretched; ange asthi ara chama — on his body [only] bones and skin

4In Dravida there was a brahmana named Rama,
utterly wretched: on his body only bones and skin.

অন্নকষ্টে দগ্ধ সেই জঠর-অনলে ।
রক্ত-মাংস নাহি তার শুষ্ক কলেবরে ॥ ৫ ॥

annakaṣṭe dagdha sei jaṭhara-anale |
rakta-māṃsa nāhi tāra śuṣka kalebare || 5 ||

anna-kashte — through want of food; dagdha sei jathara-anale — he is burnt by the fire of hunger; rakta-mamsa nahi tara — he has no blood or flesh; shushka kalevare — in his withered body

5Wasted by hunger, he is burnt by the fire of hunger;
there is no blood or flesh in his withered body.

দুরন্ত দারিদ্র্য-দুঃখ কত সহা যায় ।
মনে মনে চিন্তে বিপ্র তরণ-উপায় ॥ ৬ ॥

duranta dāridrya-duḥkha kata sahā yāẏa |
mane mane cinte bipra taraṇa-upāẏa || 6 ||

duranta daridrya-duhkha — the cruel misery of poverty; kata saha yaya — how much can be borne; mane mane chinte vipra — the brahmana ponders within; tarana-upaya — a means of deliverance

6How much can the cruel misery of poverty be borne?
The brahmana ponders within on a means of deliverance:

পূর্বজন্মে কৈলুঁ মুঞি অনেক অধর্ম ।
দরিদ্র হইলুঁ মুঞি সেই সব কর্ম ॥ ৭ ॥

pūrbajanme kailuṁ muñi aneka adharma |
daridra hailuṁ muñi sei saba karma || 7 ||

purvajanme kailun munyi — in a former birth I did; aneka adharma — much wrong; daridra hailun munyi — I have become poor; sei saba karma — through all those deeds

7"In a former birth I did much wrong —
through all those deeds I have become poor.

না ভুঞ্জিলে নাহি ঘুচে অদৃষ্ট-লিখন ।
দুরন্ত যন্ত্রণা-দুঃখ ঘুচয়ে কেমন ॥ ৮ ॥

nā bhuñjile nāhi ghuce adṛṣṭa-likhana |
duranta yantraṇā-duḥkha ghucaẏe kemana || 8 ||

na bhunjile — without undergoing [the fruits]; nahi ghuche adrishta-likhana — the writing of fate is not erased; duranta yantrana-duhkha — cruel torment and misery; ghuchaye kemana — how can they end

8Without undergoing [the fruits], the writing of fate is not erased —
how then can this cruel torment and misery end?"

চিন্তিতে চিন্তিতে বিপ্র পাইল প্রতিকার ।
প্রভু বিনা নারে কেহো কর্ম ঘুচাবার ॥ ৯ ॥

cintite cintite bipra pāila pratikāra |
prabhu binā nāre keho karma ghucābāra || 9 ||

chintite chintite — pondering and pondering; vipra paila pratikara — the brahmana found a remedy; prabhu vina — except the Lord; nare keho karma ghuchabara — no one can remove karma

9Pondering and pondering, the brahmana found a remedy:
"Except the Lord, no one can remove karma.

জগন্নাথ নীলাচলে আছয়ে সাক্ষাতে ।
তাঁর ঠাঞি যাঙ মুঞি যাচ্ঞা করিতে ॥ ১০ ॥

jagannātha nīlācale āchaẏe sākṣāte |
tāṁra ṭhāñi yāṅa muñi yācñā karite || 10 ||

jagannatha nilachale — Jagannatha in Nilachala; achhaye sakshate — is present in person; tanra thanyi yanga munyi — I will go to Him; yachnya karite — to beg

10Jagannatha is present in person in Nilachala —
I will go to Him to beg.

অন্নকষ্টে মরোঁ মুঞি ব্রাহ্মণ-শরীর ।
বিপ্রপ্রিয় বলি' তাঁরে বোলে সব ধীর ॥ ১১ ॥

annakaṣṭe maroṁ muñi brāhmaṇa-śarīra |
biprapriẏa bali' tāṁre bole saba dhīra || 11 ||

anna-kashte maron munyi — I am dying of hunger; brahmana-sharira — in a brahmana's body; vipra-priya bali — as "fond of brahmanas"; tanre bole saba dhira — all the wise speak of Him

11I, in a brahmana's body, am dying of hunger —
and all the wise call Him fond of brahmanas.

মোর দোষে মোরে যদি না করে অবধান ।
তাঁহার উপরে বধ—ত্যজিব পরাণ ॥ ১২ ॥

mora doṣe more yadi nā kare abadhāna |
tāṁhāra upare badha—tyajiba parāṇa || 12 ||

mora doshe — for my fault; more yadi na kare avadhana — if He pays me no heed; tanhara upare vadha — the [sin of] killing on Him; tyajiba parana — I will give up my life

12If for my fault He pays me no heed,
the [sin of] killing [a brahmana] will be on Him — I shall give up my life"2.

এইমতে অনুমানি' চলিলা ব্রাহ্মণ ।
ক্রমে ক্রমে গেলা যথা কমললোচন ॥ ১৩ ॥

eimate anumāni' calilā brāhmaṇa |
krame krame gelā yathā kamalalocana || 13 ||

eimate anumani — reasoning thus; chalila brahmana — the brahmana set out; krame krame gela — gradually came; yatha kamala-lochana — to where the Lotus-eyed One is

13Reasoning thus, the brahmana set out
and step by step came to where the Lotus-eyed One is.

জগন্নাথ দেখি' করে নিজ-নিবেদন ।
অন্নকষ্টে মরোঁ মুঞি দরিদ্র ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ১৪ ॥

jagannātha dekhi' kare nija-nibedana |
annakaṣṭe maroṁ muñi daridra brāhmaṇa || 14 ||

jagannatha dekhi — seeing Jagannatha; kare nija-nivedana — he makes his plea; anna-kashte maron munyi — I am dying of hunger; daridra brahmana — a poor brahmana

14Seeing Jagannatha, he makes his plea:
"I, a poor brahmana, am dying of hunger.

তো বিনু নাহিক কেহো, রাখহ জীবন ।
ঘুচাও দারিদ্র্য-জ্বালা, দেহ মোরে ধন ॥ ১৫ ॥

to binu nāhika keho, rākhaha jībana |
ghucāo dāridrya-jbālā, deha more dhana || 15 ||

to vinu nahika keho — there is no one but You; rakhaha jivana — save my life; ghuchao daridrya-jvala — remove the burning of poverty; deha more dhana — give me wealth

15There is no one but You — save my life:
remove the burning of poverty, give me wealth."

ইহা বলি' সেদিন আছিলা সেই মনে ।
ভিক্ষায় পাইল যাহা করিল ভোজনে ॥ ১৬ ॥

ihā bali' sedina āchilā sei mane |
bhikṣāẏa pāila yāhā karila bhojane || 16 ||

iha bali — saying this; sedina achhila sei mane — that day he remained in that mind; bhikshaya paila yaha — what he got as alms; karila bhojane — he ate

16Saying this, he remained all that day in that mind
and ate what he received as alms.

তার পর-দিন পুনঃ করে নিবেদন ।
ঘুচাও দারিদ্র্য প্রভু, মরয়ে ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ১৭ ॥

tāra para-dina punaḥ kare nibedana |
ghucāo dāridrya prabhu, maraẏe brāhmaṇa || 17 ||

tara para-dina — on the next day; punah kare nivedana — again he pleads; ghuchao daridrya prabhu — remove my poverty, Lord; maraye brahmana — a brahmana is dying

17On the next day he pleads again:
"Remove my poverty, Lord — a brahmana is dying!

প্রচুর করিয়া ধন দেহ ত আমারে ।
এ দুঃখ না পাঙ যেন আজন্ম-ভিতরে ॥ ১৮ ॥

pracura kariẏā dhana deha ta āmāre |
e duḥkha nā pāṅa yena ājanma-bhitare || 18 ||

prachura kariya — in abundance; dhana deha ta amare — give me wealth; e duhkha na panga yena — that I may not suffer this misery; ajanma-bhitare — for the rest of my life

18Give me wealth in abundance,
that I may not know this misery for the rest of my life.

ধন-বর মাগোঁ প্রভু, না হও বিমুখ ।
নহিলে জীবন দিব তোমার সম্মুখ ॥ ১৯ ॥

dhana-bara māgoṁ prabhu, nā hao bimukha |
nahile jībana diba tomāra sammukha || 19 ||

dhana-vara magon — I beg the boon of wealth; prabhu na hao vimukha — Lord, do not turn away; nahile — otherwise; jivana diba tomara sammukha — I will give up my life before You

19I beg the boon of wealth, Lord — do not turn away,
or else I will give up my life before You."

ইহা বলি' উপবাস কৈল অনুবন্ধ ।
এথা নিজ-মেলে আছে প্রভু গৌরচন্দ্র ॥ ২০ ॥

ihā bali' upabāsa kaila anubandha |
ethā nija-mele āche prabhu gauracandra || 20 ||

iha bali — saying this; upavasa kaila anubandha — he began an unbroken fast; etha — meanwhile here; nija-mele achhe — among His own is; prabhu gaurachandra — Lord Gaurachandra

20Saying this, he began an unbroken fast.
And here, among His own, is Lord Gaurachandra.

নিজজন-সঙ্গে বৃন্দাবন-গুণ গায় ।
আচম্বিতে খেদ উঠে প্রভুর হিয়ায় ॥ ২১ ॥

nijajana-saṅge bṛndābana-guṇa gāẏa |
ācambite kheda uṭhe prabhura hiẏāẏa || 21 ||

nijajana-sange — with His own; vrindavana-guna gaya — He sings the glories of Vrindavana; achambite — suddenly; kheda uthe prabhura hiyaya — sorrow rises in the Lord's heart

21With His own He sings the glories of Vrindavana —
and suddenly sorrow rises in the Lord's heart.

বিস্মিত হইয়া রহে—হিয়া ভেল আন ।
যে রসে আছিলা তাহা কৈল সমাধান ॥ ২২ ॥

bismita haiẏā rahe—hiẏā bhela āna |
ye rase āchilā tāhā kaila samādhāna || 22 ||

vismita haiya rahe — He remains astonished; hiya bhela ana — His heart became otherwise; ye rase achhila — the rasa He was in; taha kaila samadhana — He brought to an end

22He remains in astonishment — His heart has become otherwise;
the rasa He was in He left off.

সভার হৃদয়ে দুঃখ বিস্ময় লাগিল ।
আচম্বিতে প্রভু কেনে আনমন হৈল ॥ ২৩ ॥

sabhāra hṛdaẏe duḥkha bismaẏa lāgila |
ācambite prabhu kene ānamana haila || 23 ||

sabhara hridaye — in the hearts of all; duhkha vismaya lagila — sorrow and wonder arose; achambite prabhu — why suddenly the Lord; kene anamana haila — became absent-minded

23In the hearts of all — sorrow and wonder:
why has the Lord suddenly become absent-minded?

এথা তিন উপবাস করিল ব্রাহ্মণ ।
জগন্নাথ-স্থানে কিছু না পায় বচন ॥ ২৪ ॥

ethā tina upabāsa karila brāhmaṇa |
jagannātha-sthāne kichu nā pāẏa bacana || 24 ||

etha — meanwhile; tina upavasa karila brahmana — the brahmana fasted three days; jagannatha-sthane — from Jagannatha; kichhu na paya vachana — he receives no word

24Meanwhile the brahmana fasted three days —
and receives no word from Jagannatha.

তবে ত ব্রাহ্মণ কৈল সাত উপবাস ।
জগন্নাথদেব কিছু না করে আশ্বাস ॥ ২৫ ॥

tabe ta brāhmaṇa kaila sāta upabāsa |
jagannāthadeba kichu nā kare āśbāsa || 25 ||

tabe ta brahmana — then the brahmana; kaila sata upavasa — fasted seven days; jagannatha-deva — Jagannatha-deva; kichhu na kare ashvasa — gives no assurance

25Then the brahmana fasted seven days —
Jagannatha-deva gives him no comfort.

দুর্বল হইল বিপ্র ক্ষীণ উপবাসে ।
সমুদ্রে মরিব বলি' দঢ়াইল শেষে ॥ ২৬ ॥

durbala haila bipra kṣīṇa upabāse |
samudre mariba bali' daṛhāila śeṣe || 26 ||

durbala haila vipra — the brahmana grew weak; kshina upavase — wasted by fasting; samudre mariba bali — "I shall die in the ocean"; dadhaila sheshe — he resolved at last

26The brahmana grew weak, wasted by fasting,
and at last resolved: "I shall die in the ocean."

সমুদ্রের কূলে বিপ্র গেলা ধীরি ধীরি ।
স্থান দেহ, সমুদ্রেরে বোলে নমস্করি' ॥ ২৭ ॥

samudrera kūle bipra gelā dhīri dhīri |
sthāna deha, samudrere bole namaskari' || 27 ||

samudrera kule — to the ocean shore; vipra gela dhiri dhiri — the brahmana went slowly; sthana deha — "give me a place"; samudrere bole namaskari — he says to the ocean, bowing

27Slowly the brahmana went to the ocean shore
and, bowing to the ocean, says: "Give me a place."

হেনকালে দেখে এক পুরুষ বিশাল ।
সমুদ্রের মধ্যে আইসে পর্বত-আকার ॥ ২৮ ॥

henakāle dekhe eka puruṣa biśāla |
samudrera madhye āise parbata-ākāra || 28 ||

henakale — at that moment; dekhe eka purusha vishala — he sees a huge person; samudrera madhye aise — coming through the midst of the ocean; parvata-akara — the size of a mountain

28At that moment he sees a huge person,
the size of a mountain, coming through the midst of the ocean.

দেখিয়া ব্রাহ্মণ মনে চিন্তিতে লাগিল ।
সমুদ্রের মাঝ দিয়া এ কেবা আইল ॥ ২৯ ॥

dekhiẏā brāhmaṇa mane cintite lāgila |
samudrera mājha diẏā e kebā āila || 29 ||

dekhiya — seeing; brahmana mane chintite lagila — the brahmana began to ponder; samudrera majha diya — through the midst of the ocean; e keba aila — who is this that has come

29Seeing this, the brahmana began to ponder:
"Who is this coming through the midst of the ocean?"

সমুদ্রের মাঝে তার এক হাঁটু পানি ।
এই সব দেখি' বিপ্র মনে মনে গণি ॥ ২৯+১ ॥

samudrera mājhe tāra eka hāṁṭu pāni |
ei saba dekhi' bipra mane mane gaṇi || 29+1 ||

samudrera majhe — in the midst of the ocean; tara eka hantu pani — the water is knee-deep for him; ei saba dekhi — seeing all this; vipra mane mane gani — the brahmana reflects within

29+1In the midst of the ocean the water is knee-deep for him —
seeing all this, the brahmana reflects within3.

দেখিতে দেখিতে কূলে দেখে সেই জন ।
সামান্য মানুষ যেন হইল তখন ॥ ৩০ ॥

dekhite dekhite kūle dekhe sei jana |
sāmānya mānuṣa yena haila takhana || 30 ||

dekhite dekhite — even as he looked; kule dekhe sei jana — he sees that person on the shore; samanya manusha yena — like an ordinary man; haila takhana — he became then

30Even as he looked, he sees that person on the shore:
he became like an ordinary man.

বিপ্র বোলে—এই জগন্নাথ বিদ্যমান ।
সমুদ্রের মাঝে আর কাহার পয়াণ ॥ ৩১ ॥

bipra bole—ei jagannātha bidyamāna |
samudrera mājhe āra kāhāra paẏāṇa || 31 ||

vipra bole — the brahmana says; ei jagannatha vidyamana — this is Jagannatha in person; samudrera majhe — through the midst of the ocean; ara kahara payana — whose else [could be] the passage

31The brahmana says: "This is Jagannatha Himself in person!
Who else could pass through the midst of the ocean?"

ইহা বলি' তার পাছু গোড়াইয়া যায় ।
কথোদূর গিয়া পাছু চাহে মহাশয় ॥ ৩২ ॥

ihā bali' tāra pāchu goṛāiẏā yāẏa |
kathodūra giẏā pāchu cāhe mahāśaẏa || 32 ||

iha bali — saying so; tara pachhu goraiya yaya — he runs after him; kathodura giya — after going some way; pachhu chahe mahashaya — the great one looks back

32Saying so, he runs after him;
after going some way, the great one looks back

দেখিল—ব্রাহ্মণ সেই আইসে পাছে পাছে ।
কোথা যাবে বলিয়া বিপ্রেরে কিছু পুছে ॥ ৩৩ ॥

dekhila—brāhmaṇa sei āise pāche pāche |
kothā yābe baliẏā biprere kichu puche || 33 ||

dekhila — he saw; brahmana sei aise pachhe pachhe — that brahmana coming behind; kotha yabe baliya — "where are you going?"; viprere kichhu puchhe — he asks the brahmana

33and sees that brahmana following him.
"Where are you going?" he asks the brahmana.

ব্রাহ্মণ কহয়ে—শুন শুন মহাশয় ।
কে তুমি, কোথারে যাবে—কহ না নিশ্চয় ॥ ৩৪ ॥

brāhmaṇa kahaẏe—śuna śuna mahāśaẏa |
ke tumi, kothāre yābe—kaha nā niścaẏa || 34 ||

brahmana kahaye — the brahmana says; shuna shuna mahashaya — listen, listen, great one; ke tumi — who are you; kothare yabe — where are you going; kaha na nishchaya — tell me truly

34The brahmana says: "Listen, listen, great one!
Who are you, where are you going? Tell me truly.

সাত-উপবাসী আমি ব্রাহ্মণ দুর্বল ।
তোমারে দেখিনু আজি, জনম সফল ॥ ৩৫ ॥

sāta-upabāsī āmi brāhmaṇa durbala |
tomāre dekhinu āji, janama saphala || 35 ||

sata-upavasi ami — I have fasted seven days; brahmana durbala — a weakened brahmana; tomare dekhinu aji — today I have seen you; janama saphala — my life is fulfilled

35I am a weakened brahmana; I have fasted seven days;
today I have seen you — my life is fulfilled.

নিশ্চয় করিয়া কহ, না ভাঁড়িহ মোরে ।
নহে বা ব্রাহ্মণ-বধ লাগিব তোমারে ॥ ৩৬ ॥

niścaẏa kariẏā kaha, nā bhāṁṛiha more |
nahe bā brāhmaṇa-badha lāgiba tomāre || 36 ||

nishchaya kariya kaha — tell me for certain; na bhandiha more — do not deceive me; nahe va — or else; brahmana-vadha lagiba tomare — the [sin of] killing a brahmana will cling to you

36Tell me for certain, do not deceive me,
or else the [sin of] killing a brahmana will be on you."

এ বোল শুনিঞা তবে বোলে মহাজন ।
আমা জানিবারে তোমার কি কাজ যতন ॥ ৩৭ ॥

e bola śuniñā tabe bole mahājana |
āmā jānibāre tomāra ki kāja yatana || 37 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; tabe bole mahajana — then the great one says; ama janibare — to know me; tomara ki kaja yatana — what need have you to strive

37Hearing this, the great one says:
"What need have you to strive to know me?

যে হই সে হই আমি, তোর কিবা দায় ।
কেনে উপবাসী মর দুরন্ত হিয়ায় ॥ ৩৮ ॥

ye hai se hai āmi, tora kibā dāẏa |
kene upabāsī mara duranta hiẏāẏa || 38 ||

ye hai se hai ami — whoever I may be; tora kiba daya — what concern is it of yours; kene upavasi mara — why do you die fasting; duranta hiyaya — with a desperate heart

38Whoever I may be — what concern is it of yours?
Why do you die fasting with a desperate heart?"

ব্রাহ্মণ কহয়ে—দুঃখ-দারিদ্র্যের জ্বরে ।
জর্জর করিল মোর সব কলেবরে ॥ ৩৯ ॥

brāhmaṇa kahaẏe—duḥkha-dāridryera jbare |
jarjara karila mora saba kalebare || 39 ||

brahmana kahaye — the brahmana says; duhkha-daridryera jvare — the fever of misery and poverty; jarjara karila — has wasted; mora saba kalevare — my whole body

39The brahmana says: "The fever of misery and poverty
has wasted my whole body.

ব্রাহ্মণের ধরম নাহিক আমা ছারে ।
এ দিবা-রজনী যায় অন্ন-হাহাকারে ॥ ৪০ ॥

brāhmaṇera dharama nāhika āmā chāre |
e dibā-rajanī yāẏa anna-hāhākāre || 40 ||

brahmanera dharama — a brahmana's duties; nahika ama chhare — wretched me cannot keep; e diva-rajani yaya — day and night pass; anna-hahakare — in wailing for food

40A brahmana's duties wretched me cannot keep:
day and night pass in wailing for food.

নিজকুলে আদর নাহিক কোনখানে ।
না জানিয়ে কোন্ ঠাঞি নাহি অপমানে ॥ ৪১ ॥

nijakule ādara nāhika konakhāne |
nā jāniẏe kon ṭhāñi nāhi apamāne || 41 ||

nija-kule adara nahika — in my own family there is no regard; konakhane — anywhere; na janiye kon thanyi — I know no place; nahi apamane — where there is no insult

41In my own family I find no regard anywhere;
I know no place where I am not insulted.

জীবন-অধিক সে মরণ ভালবাসি ।
কহিল তোমারে তেঞি মরোঁ উপবাসী ॥ ৪২ ॥

jībana-adhika se maraṇa bhālabāsi |
kahila tomāre teñi maroṁ upabāsī || 42 ||

jivana-adhika — more than life; se marana bhalabasi — I love death; kahila tomare — I tell you; tenyi maron upavasi — that is why I die fasting

42I love death more than life —
I tell you: that is why I am dying by fasting."

এ বোল শুনিঞা চিত্ত দ্রবে মহাজন ।
বিভীষণ নাম মোর—শুনহ ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ৪৩ ॥

e bola śuniñā citta drabe mahājana |
bibhīṣaṇa nāma mora—śunaha brāhmaṇa || 43 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; chitta drave mahajana — the great one's heart melts; vibhishana nama mora — my name is Vibhishana; shunaha brahmana — listen, brahmana

43Hearing this, the great one's heart melted:
"My name is Vibhishana; listen, brahmana.

দেখিবারে যাই জগন্নাথের চরণ ।
কর্মদোষে দুঃখ পাও, শুনহ ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ৪৪ ॥

dekhibāre yāi jagannāthera caraṇa |
karmadoṣe duḥkha pāo, śunaha brāhmaṇa || 44 ||

dekhibare yai — I go to see; jagannathera charana — Jagannatha's feet; karma-doshe duhkha pao — you suffer through the fault of karma; shunaha brahmana — listen, brahmana

44I am going to see Jagannatha's feet.
You suffer through the fault of your karma; listen, brahmana.

কর্মবন্ধে বন্দী লোক সুখ-দুঃখ লাভ ।
ভুঞ্জিলে সে ঘুচে সেই কর্ম-পুণ্য-পাপ ॥ ৪৫ ॥

karmabandhe bandī loka sukha-duḥkha lābha |
bhuñjile se ghuce sei karma-puṇya-pāpa || 45 ||

karma-bandhe bandi loka — people bound in the fetters of karma; sukha-duhkha labha — receive joy and sorrow; bhunjile se ghuche — only by undergoing it is ended; sei karma-punya-papa — that karma, pious and sinful

45People bound in the fetters of karma receive joy and sorrow;
only by undergoing them is that karma, pious and sinful, ended.

জগন্নাথ-মুখ দেখ করিয়া পিরীত ।
জন্মান্তরে নহে যেন দুঃখ-উপনীত ॥ ৪৬ ॥

jagannātha-mukha dekha kariẏā pirīta |
janmāntare nahe yena duḥkha-upanīta || 46 ||

jagannatha-mukha dekha — look on Jagannatha's face; kariya pirita — with love; janmantare nahe yena — that in another birth there may not be; duhkha-upanita — misery coming upon you

46Look with love on Jagannatha's face,
that in another birth too misery may not befall you."

ইহা বলি' চলিলেন রাজা বিভীষণ ।
পাছে পাছে যায় তবু দরিদ্র ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ৪৭ ॥

ihā bali' calilena rājā bibhīṣaṇa |
pāche pāche yāẏa tabu daridra brāhmaṇa || 47 ||

iha bali — saying this; chalilena raja vibhishana — King Vibhishana went on; pachhe pachhe yaya tabu — yet behind him goes; daridra brahmana — the poor brahmana

47Saying this, King Vibhishana went on,
yet the poor brahmana still follows behind him.

বসি' আছে গোরাচাঁদ নিজজন-মেলে ।
দুয়ারে কে আছে দেখ, গোবিন্দেরে বোলে ॥ ৪৮ ॥

basi' āche gorācāṁda nijajana-mele |
duẏāre ke āche dekha, gobindere bole || 48 ||

basi achhe gorachanda — Gorachand is sitting; nijajana-mele — among His own; duyare ke achhe dekha — see who is at the door; govindere bole — He says to Govinda

48Gorachand is sitting among His own;
He says to Govinda: "See who is at the door."

দুয়ারে দাঁড়াঞা আছে বিভীষণ রায় ।
ব্রাহ্মণ দেখিয়া অঙ্গুলি দিল নাসিকায় ॥ ৪৯ ॥

duẏāre dāṁṛāñā āche bibhīṣaṇa rāẏa |
brāhmaṇa dekhiẏā aṅguli dila nāsikāẏa || 49 ||

duyare dadanya achhe — at the door stands; vibhishana raya — King Vibhishana; brahmana dekhiya — seeing the brahmana; anguli dila nasikaya — he put a finger to his nose

49At the door stands King Vibhishana;
seeing the brahmana, he put a finger to his nose4.

হেনকালে গেলা গোবিন্দ টোটার দুয়ার ।
দেখিল দুয়ারে দুই ব্রাহ্মণ-কুমার ॥ ৫০ ॥

henakāle gelā gobinda ṭoṭāra duẏāra |
dekhila duẏāre dui brāhmaṇa-kumāra || 50 ||

henakale — at that moment; gela govinda totara duyara — Govinda went to the garden gate; dekhila duyare — he saw at the gate; dui brahmana-kumara — two young brahmanas

50At that moment Govinda went to the garden gate
and saw at the gate two young brahmanas.

দেখিয়া গোবিন্দ গেলা প্রভু-বিদ্যমান ।
কিছু না কহিতে ডাকে ব্রাহ্মণ দুইজন ॥ ৫১ ॥

dekhiẏā gobinda gelā prabhu-bidyamāna |
kichu nā kahite ḍāke brāhmaṇa duijana || 51 ||

dekhiya — seeing them; govinda gela prabhu-vidyamana — Govinda went before the Lord; kichhu na kahite — before he said anything; dake brahmana duijana — [the Lord] calls the two brahmanas

51Seeing them, Govinda went to the Lord,
but before he could say anything, [the Lord] calls the two brahmanas.

আইস আইস বলি' হাসি' সম্ভাষে ঠাকুর ।
একে বসাইল পাশে, আর রহে দূর ॥ ৫২ ॥

āisa āisa bali' hāsi' sambhāṣe ṭhākura |
eke basāila pāśe, āra rahe dūra || 52 ||

aisa aisa bali — saying "come, come"; hasi sambhashe thakura — the Thakura greets them smiling; eke basaila pashe — He seated one beside Him; ara rahe dura — the other stays at a distance

52"Come in, come in!" the Thakura greets them with a smile;
He seated one beside Him, while the other stays at a distance.

সব ছাড়ি' প্রভু তারে সম্ভাষে আদরে ।
কাছে যত ছিল বিস্ময় লাগিল সভারে ॥ ৫৩ ॥

saba chāṛi' prabhu tāre sambhāṣe ādare |
kāche yata chila bismaẏa lāgila sabhāre || 53 ||

saba chhadi — leaving everything; prabhu tare sambhashe adare — the Lord converses with him with honour; kachhe yata chhila — all who were near; vismaya lagila sabhare — all were amazed

53Leaving everything, the Lord converses with him with honour;
all who were near were amazed.

ঠাকুর কহয়ে—চিরদিনে দরশন ।
অনুরাগে দোঁহাকার ঝরয়ে নয়ন ॥ ৫৪ ॥

ṭhākura kahaẏe—ciradine daraśana |
anurāge doṁhākāra jharaẏe naẏana || 54 ||

thakura kahaye — the Thakura says; chiradine darashana — we meet after a long time; anurage — in love; donhakara jharaye nayana — tears flow from the eyes of both

54The Thakura says: "We meet after a long time!" —
and tears of love flow from the eyes of both.

হস্ত দিয়া অঙ্গ পরশয়ে তাহার ।
কুশল কুশল পুছে ইঙ্গিত-আকার ॥ ৫৫ ॥

hasta diẏā aṅga paraśaẏe tāhāra |
kuśala kuśala puche iṅgita-ākāra || 55 ||

hasta diya — with His hand; anga parashaye tahara — He touches his body; kushala kushala puchhe — He asks "are you well?"; ingita-akara — by signs and looks

55He touches his body with His hand
and by signs asks: "Are you well?"

সে দোঁহার কথা আর না বুঝয়ে কেহো ।
গৌরচন্দ্র বোলে—বিপ্র দুঃখিত বড় এহো ॥ ৫৬ ॥

se doṁhāra kathā āra nā bujhaẏe keho |
gauracandra bole—bipra duḥkhita baṛa eho || 56 ||

se donhara katha — the talk of those two; ara na bujhaye keho — no one else understands; gaurachandra bole — Gaurachandra says; vipra duhkhita bada eho — this brahmana is very wretched

56No one else understands the talk of those two.
Gaurachandra says: "This brahmana is very wretched.

দারিদ্র্য-জ্বালায় জ্ঞান হরিল ইহার ।
জগন্নাথ-উপরে এ করয়ে প্রহার ॥ ৫৭ ॥

dāridrya-jbālāẏa jñāna harila ihāra |
jagannātha-upare e karaẏe prahāra || 57 ||

daridrya-jvalaya — the burning of poverty; jnana harila ihara — has robbed him of reason; jagannatha-upare — on Jagannatha; e karaye prahara — he makes an attack

57The burning of poverty has robbed him of reason:
he is attacking Jagannatha.

আপনার দোষ জীব না দেখয়ে কিছু ।
আপনি করিয়া দোষ প্রভুরে দোষে পাছু ॥ ৫৮ ॥

āpanāra doṣa jība nā dekhaẏe kichu |
āpani kariẏā doṣa prabhure doṣe pāchu || 58 ||

apanara dosha — its own fault; jiva na dekhaye kichhu — the living being does not see at all; apani kariya dosha — having itself done wrong; prabhure doshe pachhu — afterwards blames the Lord

58A living being does not see its own fault at all:
having done wrong itself, it afterwards blames the Lord.

আপনে করয়ে নিজ ভাল-মন্দ বলি' ।
ভুঞ্জিবার বেলে দোষ প্রভুর উপরি ॥ ৫৯ ॥

āpane karaẏe nija bhāla-manda bali' |
bhuñjibāra bele doṣa prabhura upari || 59 ||

apane karaye — it does itself; nija bhala-manda bali — its own good and evil; bhunjibara bele — when the time comes to reap; dosha prabhura upari — the blame is on the Lord

59It does its own good and evil itself —
and when the time comes to reap, it blames the Lord.

সুখ সে ভুঞ্জিতে গুণ কহে আপনার ।
প্রভুরে দোষয়ে দোষ-দুঃখ ভুঞ্জিবার ॥ ৬০ ॥

sukha se bhuñjite guṇa kahe āpanāra |
prabhure doṣaẏe doṣa-duḥkha bhuñjibāra || 60 ||

sukha se bhunjite — when enjoying happiness; guna kahe apanara — it speaks of its own merit; prabhure doshaye — it blames the Lord; dosha-duhkha bhunjibara — when reaping evil and sorrow

60When enjoying happiness, it speaks of its own merit,
but when reaping evil and sorrow, it blames the Lord.

সাত-উপবাসে বিপ্র মৃত্যু কৈল সার ।
বিপ্রপ্রিয় জগন্নাথ কি করিব আর ॥ ৬১ ॥

sāta-upabāse bipra mṛtyu kaila sāra |
biprapriẏa jagannātha ki kariba āra || 61 ||

sata-upavase — by a seven-day fast; vipra mrityu kaila sara — the brahmana made death his choice; vipra-priya jagannatha — Jagannatha, fond of brahmanas; ki kariba ara — what else could He do

61By a seven-day fast the brahmana chose death —
what else could Jagannatha, fond of brahmanas, do?

তোমার দর্শনে ইহার ঘুচিল দারিদ্র্য ।
ধন দেহ—যেন হয় ধনের সমুদ্র ॥ ৬২ ॥

tomāra darśane ihāra ghucila dāridrya |
dhana deha—yena haẏa dhanera samudra || 62 ||

tomara darshane — by seeing you; ihara ghuchila daridrya — his poverty is ended; dhana deha — give [him] wealth; yena haya dhanera samudra — so that it becomes an ocean of riches

62By seeing you his poverty is ended:
give him wealth — let it become an ocean of riches."

ভাল ভাল বলি' তেঁহো উঠিলা সত্বর ।
যে ছিল সেখানে সবে পড়িলা ফাঁপর ॥ ৬৩ ॥

bhāla bhāla bali' teṁho uṭhilā satbara |
ye chila sekhāne sabe paṛilā phāṁpara || 63 ||

bhala bhala bali — saying "good, good"; tenho uthila satvara — he quickly rose; ye chhila sekhane — all who were there; sabe padila phanpara — were bewildered

63"Good, good," he said and quickly rose;
all who were there were bewildered.

দণ্ডবত করি' তারা চলে দুইজন ।
পথে যাইতে বিভীষণে পুছয়ে ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ৬৪ ॥

daṇḍabata kari' tārā cale duijana |
pathe yāite bibhīṣaṇe puchaẏe brāhmaṇa || 64 ||

dandavata kari — bowing down; tara chale duijana — the two go off; pathe yaite — on the way; vibhishane puchhaye brahmana — the brahmana asks Vibhishana

64Bowing down, the two go off;
on the way the brahmana asks Vibhishana:

তুমি বোল—আমি সেই রাজা বিভীষণ ।
সন্ন্যাসীরে নমস্করি' চলিলা এখন ॥ ৬৫ ॥

tumi bola—āmi sei rājā bibhīṣaṇa |
sannyāsīre namaskari' calilā ekhana || 65 ||

tumi bola — you say; ami sei raja vibhishana — "I am that King Vibhishana"; sannyasire namaskari — bowing to the sannyasi; chalila ekhana — you are now leaving

65"You say: 'I am that King Vibhishana,' —
and now you are leaving, having bowed to a sannyasi.

জগন্নাথদেব তুমি না দেখিলে কেনে ।
স্বরূপ করিয়া কহ দুঃখিত ব্রাহ্মণে ॥ ৬৬ ॥

jagannāthadeba tumi nā dekhile kene |
sbarūpa kariẏā kaha duḥkhita brāhmaṇe || 66 ||

jagannatha-deva — Jagannatha-deva; tumi na dekhile kene — why did you not see; svarupa kariya kaha — tell the truth; duhkhita brahmane — to the wretched brahmana

66Why did you not see Jagannatha-deva?
Tell the truth to a wretched brahmana.

সন্ন্যাসীর আজ্ঞা তুমি কৈলে শিরঃপরি ।
সন্ন্যাসী বা কে বা, কহ—না কর চাতুরী ॥ ৬৭ ॥

sannyāsīra ājñā tumi kaile śiraḥpari |
sannyāsī bā ke bā, kaha—nā kara cāturī || 67 ||

sannyasira ajna — the sannyasi's order; tumi kaile shirah-pari — you placed on your head (obeyed); sannyasi va ke va kaha — tell me, who is this sannyasi; na kara chaturi — do not be clever

67You placed the sannyasi's order on your head —
tell me, who is this sannyasi? Do not be clever."

রাজা কহে—শুন আরে অবোধ ব্রাহ্মণ ।
জগন্নাথ দেখ এই সাক্ষাৎ নয়ন ॥ ৬৮ ॥

rājā kahe—śuna āre abodha brāhmaṇa |
jagannātha dekha ei sākṣāt naẏana || 68 ||

raja kahe — the king says; shuna are abodha brahmana — listen, you foolish brahmana; jagannatha dekha — you have seen Jagannatha; ei sakshat nayana — here, with your own eyes

68The king says: "Listen, foolish brahmana:
you have seen Jagannatha with your own eyes.

তোমার অভীষ্ট সিদ্ধ, ধন পাইলে তুমি ।
দ্রাবিড়ে তোমারে ধন দিব লঞা আমি ॥ ৬৯ ॥

tomāra abhīṣṭa siddha, dhana pāile tumi |
drābiṛe tomāre dhana diba lañā āmi || 69 ||

tomara abhishta siddha — your desire is fulfilled; dhana paile tumi — you have received wealth; dravide tomare — in Dravida to you; dhana diba lanya ami — I will bring and give the wealth

69Your desire is fulfilled — you have received wealth:
I shall bring you the wealth in Dravida."

এ বোল শুনিঞা বিপ্র শিরে হানে ঘা ।
আরতি করিয়া ধরে বিভীষণের পা ॥ ৭০ ॥

e bola śuniñā bipra śire hāne ghā |
ārati kariẏā dhare bibhīṣaṇera pā || 70 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; vipra shire hane gha — the brahmana strikes his head; arati kariya — in anguish; dhare vibhishanera pa — he clasps Vibhishana's feet

70Hearing this, the brahmana strikes his head
and in anguish clasps Vibhishana's feet:

পুনঃ চল যাই সেই প্রভু-বরাবরে ।
অজ্ঞান ব্রাহ্মণ মুঞি, কহোঁ মো তোমারে ॥ ৭১ ॥

punaḥ cala yāi sei prabhu-barābare |
ajñāna brāhmaṇa muñi, kahoṁ mo tomāre || 71 ||

punah chala yai — let us go again; sei prabhu-barabare — before that Lord; ajnana brahmana munyi — I am an ignorant brahmana; kahon mo tomare — I tell you

71"Let us go again before that Lord!
I am an ignorant brahmana — I tell you."

অনেক যতন কৈল এড়াইতে নারি ।
পুনঃ লেউটিয়া যায় প্রভু-বরাবরি ॥ ৭২ ॥

aneka yatana kaila eṛāite nāri |
punaḥ leuṭiẏā yāẏa prabhu-barābari || 72 ||

aneka yatana kaila — [Vibhishana] tried hard; edaite nari — but could not get away; punah leutiya yaya — they go back again; prabhu-barabari — to the Lord

72[Vibhishana] tried hard but could not get away from him,
and they go back again to the Lord.

প্রভুর সম্মুখে গেলা অন্তরে তরাস ।
পুনঃ দোঁহা দেখি' প্রভুর উপজিল হাস ॥ ৭৩ ॥

prabhura sammukhe gelā antare tarāsa |
punaḥ doṁhā dekhi' prabhura upajila hāsa || 73 ||

prabhura sammukhe gela — they came before the Lord; antare tarasa — with fear at heart; punah donha dekhi — seeing the two again; prabhura upajila hasa — the Lord laughed

73With fear at heart they came before the Lord;
seeing the two again, the Lord laughed.

প্রভু বোলে—লেউটিয়া আইলা কি কারণে ।
রাজা কহে—যে কারণ পুছহ ব্রাহ্মণে ॥ ৭৪ ॥

prabhu bole—leuṭiẏā āilā ki kāraṇe |
rājā kahe—ye kāraṇa puchaha brāhmaṇe || 74 ||

prabhu bole — the Lord says; leutiya aila ki karane — why have you come back; raja kahe — the king says; ye karana puchhaha brahmane — ask the brahmana the reason

74The Lord says: "Why have you come back?"
The king says: "Ask the brahmana the reason."

ব্রাহ্মণ কহয়ে—গোসাঞি, আমি ত অবুধ ।
কত কত জীব আছে অর্বুদ অর্বুদ ॥ ৭৫ ॥

brāhmaṇa kahaẏe—gosāñi, āmi ta abudha |
kata kata jība āche arbuda arbuda || 75 ||

brahmana kahaye — the brahmana says; gosani ami ta abudha — Gosani, I am ignorant; kata kata jiva achhe — how many living beings there are; arbuda arbuda — countless millions

75The brahmana says: "Gosani, I am ignorant.
How many living beings there are — countless millions —

সভাকার প্রাণ তুমি সভাকার নাথ ।
তো বহি নাহিক কেহো—তুমি জগন্নাথ ॥ ৭৬ ॥

sabhākāra prāṇa tumi sabhākāra nātha |
to bahi nāhika keho—tumi jagannātha || 76 ||

sabhakara prana tumi — You are the life of all; sabhakara natha — the Lord of all; to bahi nahika keho — there is no one but You; tumi jagannatha — You are Jagannatha

76You are the life of all, You are the Lord of all,
there is no one but You: You are Jagannatha.

আমি মহাধম ছার মহা-অপরাধী ।
নিজকর্ম-দোষে মোর দারিদ্র্য-রোগ-ব্যাধি ॥ ৭৭ ॥

āmi mahādhama chāra mahā-aparādhī |
nijakarma-doṣe mora dāridrya-roga-byādhi || 77 ||

ami mahadhama chhara — I am the lowest, wretched; maha-aparadhi — a great offender; nija-karma-doshe — through the fault of my own karma; mora daridrya-roga-vyadhi — I have the disease of poverty

77I am the lowest of the low, wretched, a great offender:
through the fault of my karma I have the disease of poverty.

ব্যাধি-পীড়ায়ে মো কুপথ্যে করোঁ আশা ।
ঔষধ না রুচে মুখে, কুপথ্যে প্রত্যাশা ॥ ৭৮ ॥

byādhi-pīṛāẏe mo kupathye karoṁ āśā |
auṣadha nā ruce mukhe, kupathye pratyāśā || 78 ||

vyadhi-pidaye — tormented by the disease; mo kupathye karon asha — I long for harmful food; aushadha na ruche mukhe — the medicine is not to my taste; kupathye pratyasha — I crave the harmful

78Tormented by the disease, I long for harmful food:
the medicine is not to my taste; I crave what is harmful.

বুঝিয়া ঔষধ দেহ, তুমি ধন্বন্তরি ।
কর্মদোষে ভব-ব্যাধে আমি ছার মরি ॥ ৭৯ ॥

bujhiẏā auṣadha deha, tumi dhanbantari |
karmadoṣe bhaba-byādhe āmi chāra mari || 79 ||

bujhiya aushadha deha — give the medicine with understanding; tumi dhanvantari — You are Dhanvantari; karma-doshe — through the fault of karma; bhava-vyadhe ami chhara mari — wretched I am dying of the disease of worldly existence

79Give me the medicine with understanding — You are Dhanvantari:
through the fault of karma, wretched I am dying of the disease of worldly existence."

এ বোল শুনিয়া প্রভু হাসিতে লাগিলা ।
জগন্নাথদেব তোমার সব ভাল কৈলা ॥ ৮০ ॥

e bola śuniẏā prabhu hāsite lāgilā |
jagannāthadeba tomāra saba bhāla kailā || 80 ||

e bola shuniya — hearing this; prabhu hasite lagila — the Lord began to laugh; jagannatha-deva — Jagannatha-deva; tomara saba bhala kaila — has made all well for you

80Hearing this, the Lord began to laugh:
"Jagannatha-deva has made all well for you.

আগে ত ঈপ্সিত তুমি ভুঞ্জিবে এখন ।
শেষকালে পাবে জগন্নাথের চরণ ॥ ৮১ ॥

āge ta īpsita tumi bhuñjibe ekhana |
śeṣakāle pābe jagannāthera caraṇa || 81 ||

age ta ipsita — first what you desired; tumi bhunjibe ekhana — you will enjoy now; shesha-kale — at the end; pabe jagannathera charana — you will attain Jagannatha's feet

81First you will now enjoy what you desired,
and at the end you will attain Jagannatha's feet"5.

এ বোল বলিতে বিপ্র দণ্ডবত করে ।
চৌদিগে সকল লোক হরি হরি বোলে ॥ ৮২ ॥

e bola balite bipra daṇḍabata kare |
caudige sakala loka hari hari bole || 82 ||

e bola balite — as this was said; vipra dandavata kare — the brahmana prostrates; chaudige sakala loka — all the people around; hari hari bole — cry "Hari, Hari!"

82As this was said, the brahmana prostrates;
all the people around cry: "Hari, Hari!"

শুন সর্বজন হের অপূর্ব কথন ।
বর পাঞা চলি' গেলা দরিদ্র ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ৮৩ ॥

śuna sarbajana hera apūrba kathana |
bara pāñā cali' gelā daridra brāhmaṇa || 83 ||

shuna sarvajana — hear, everyone; hera apurva kathana — this wonderful account; vara panya — receiving the boon; chali gela daridra brahmana — the poor brahmana went away

83Hear, everyone, this wonderful account:
having received the boon, the poor brahmana went away.

হরিষে হইলা দোঁহে বাড়ীর বাহির ।
ভক্তজন প্রভুরে পুছয়ে ধীরে ধীর ॥ ৮৪ ॥

hariṣe hailā doṁhe bāṛīra bāhira |
bhaktajana prabhure puchaẏe dhīre dhīra || 84 ||

harishe haila donhe — joyfully the two went; badira bahira — out of the house; bhaktajana prabhure — the devotees the Lord; puchhaye dhire dhira — ask softly

84Joyfully the two went out of the house;
the devotees softly question the Lord.

পুরীগোসাঞি বোলে—প্রভু, দয়া কর যদি ।
ইহার কারণ কহ, সভে কর শুদ্ধি ॥ ৮৫ ॥

purīgosāñi bole—prabhu, daẏā kara yadi |
ihāra kāraṇa kaha, sabhe kara śuddhi || 85 ||

puri-gosani bole — Puri Gosani says; prabhu daya kara yadi — Lord, if You are kind; ihara karana kaha — tell us the meaning of this; sabhe kara shuddhi — purify us all

85Puri Gosani says: "Lord, if You are kind,
tell us the meaning of this; purify us all."

সুধাইতে নারে কেহো, মনে বড় ইচ্ছা ।
সাহস করিয়া মুঞি সুধাইল পিছা ॥ ৮৬ ॥

sudhāite nāre keho, mane baṛa icchā |
sāhasa kariẏā muñi sudhāila pichā || 86 ||

sudhaite nare keho — no one dares to ask; mane bada ichchha — though the desire is great; sahasa kariya munyi — daring, I; sudhaila pichha — asked afterwards

86No one dares to ask, though the desire is great —
and I, daring, asked afterwards6.

ঠাকুর কহয়ে—শুন শুনহ গোসাঞি ।
এ কথা তোমরা সভে কিছু বুঝ নাঞি ॥ ৮৭ ॥

ṭhākura kahaẏe—śuna śunaha gosāñi |
e kathā tomarā sabhe kichu bujha nāñi || 87 ||

thakura kahaye — the Thakura says; shuna shunaha gosani — listen, listen, Gosani; e katha tomara sabhe — this matter you all; kichhu bujha nanyi — have not understood at all

87The Thakura says: "Listen, listen, Gosani:
none of you has understood this at all.

দ্রাবিড়ে আছিল এই দরিদ্র ব্রাহ্মণ ।
অনেক যন্ত্রণা-দুঃখ পাঞাছে তখন ॥ ৮৮ ॥

drābiṛe āchila ei daridra brāhmaṇa |
aneka yantraṇā-duḥkha pāñāche takhana || 88 ||

dravide achhila — there lived in Dravida; ei daridra brahmana — this poor brahmana; aneka yantrana-duhkha — much torment and misery; panyachhe takhana — he suffered then

88This poor brahmana lived in Dravida
and suffered much torment and misery there.

দারিদ্র্য-জ্বালায় দগ্ধ আইল এই দেশে ।
জগন্নাথ-উপরে প্রহার করে শেষে ॥ ৮৯ ॥

dāridrya-jbālāẏa dagdha āila ei deśe |
jagannātha-upare prahāra kare śeṣe || 89 ||

daridrya-jvalaya dagdha — burnt by the fire of poverty; aila ei deshe — he came to this land; jagannatha-upare — on Jagannatha; prahara kare sheshe — at last he made an attack

89Burnt by the fire of poverty he came to this land
and at last attacked Jagannatha.

দুঃখিত দেখিয়া তুষ্ট হৈলা জগন্নাথ ।
আচম্বিতে বিভীষণ-সনে হৈল সাথ ॥ ৯০ ॥

duḥkhita dekhiẏā tuṣṭa hailā jagannātha |
ācambite bibhīṣaṇa-sane haila sātha || 90 ||

duhkhita dekhiya — seeing [him] wretched; tushta haila jagannatha — Jagannatha was gracious; achambite — unexpectedly; vibhishana-sane haila satha — [he] met with Vibhishana

90Seeing him wretched, Jagannatha was gracious —
and unexpectedly he met with Vibhishana.

বিভীষণ এই যে বসিল মোর পাশে ।
ধন-দান কৈল তেঁহো ব্রাহ্মণ-সন্তোষে ॥ ৯১ ॥

bibhīṣaṇa ei ye basila mora pāśe |
dhana-dāna kaila teṁho brāhmaṇa-santoṣe || 91 ||

vibhishana ei ye — this is Vibhishana, who; basila mora pashe — sat beside Me; dhana-dana kaila tenho — he gave wealth; brahmana-santoshe — to the brahmana's satisfaction

91It was Vibhishana who sat beside Me:
he gave the wealth, to the brahmana's satisfaction."

এ বোল শুনিয়া সর্বজনের উল্লাস ।
প্রেমায় ভাসিল সব এ ভূমি-আকাশ ॥ ৯২ ॥

e bola śuniẏā sarbajanera ullāsa |
premāẏa bhāsila saba e bhūmi-ākāśa || 92 ||

e bola shuniya — hearing this; sarvajanera ullasa — all rejoiced; premaya bhasila — were flooded with prema; saba e bhumi-akasha — all this earth and sky

92Hearing this, all rejoiced;
all this earth and sky were flooded with prema.

সর্বজন নাচে, সভে বোলে হরিবোল ।
আনন্দে সভাই সভে ধরি' দেই কোল ॥ ৯৩ ॥

sarbajana nāce, sabhe bole haribola |
ānande sabhāi sabhe dhari' dei kola || 93 ||

sarvajana nache — all dance; sabhe bole hari-bola — all cry "Hari-bol!"; anande sabhai sabhe — in joy all one another; dhari dei kola — embrace

93All dance, all cry: "Hari-bol!" —
and in joy all embrace one another.

শুন সর্বজন গোরাচাঁদের প্রকাশ ।
শেষখণ্ড সায় কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৯৪ ॥

śuna sarbajana gorācāṁdera prakāśa |
śeṣakhaṇḍa sāẏa kahe e locanadāsa || 94 ||

shuna sarvajana — hear, everyone; gorachandera prakasha — the manifestation of Gorachand; shesha-khanda saya — [thus] ends the Shesha-khanda; kahe e lochanadasa — says this Lochana Dasa

94Hear, everyone, of Gorachand's manifestation;
thus ends the Shesha-khanda, says this Lochana Dasa7.

The Concealment of the Lord (chapter 4)

Raga dhanashi; disha: "O Lord, glory, glory to Gaurangachand! He has caught the minds of living beings in the net of prema"

অবনিমণ্ডলে গোরা রূপের অবধি ।
বিলাইলা প্রেমধন আচণ্ডাল আদি ॥ ৯৪+১ ॥

abanimaṇḍale gorā rūpera abadhi |
bilāilā premadhana ācaṇḍāla ādi || 94+1 ||

avani-mandale — on the circle of the earth; gora rupera avadhi — Gora, the utmost of beauty; vilaila prema-dhana — gave away the treasure of prema; achandala adi — [to all,] down to the chandalas

94+1Gora, the utmost of beauty on the circle of the earth,
gave away the treasure of prema to all, down to the chandalas8.

বাচাল করয়ে গোরা-গুণে মূক জনে ।
পঙ্গু গিরি লঙ্ঘে, অন্ধে দেখে তারাগণে ॥ ৯৪+২ ॥

bācāla karaẏe gorā-guṇe mūka jane |
paṅgu giri laṅghe, andhe dekhe tārāgaṇe || 94+2 ||

vachala karaye — makes eloquent; gora-gune muka jane — the mute, through Gora's glories; pangu giri langhe — the lame leaps over mountains; andhe dekhe taragane — the blind sees the stars

94+2Gora's glories make the mute eloquent:
the lame leaps over mountains, the blind sees the stars.

কহিতে কহিতে নাহি জানি নিজ-পর ।
যে উঠয়ে তাহা বলি, না করয়ে ডর ॥ ৯৪+৩ ॥

kahite kahite nāhi jāni nija-para |
ye uṭhaẏe tāhā bali, nā karaẏe ḍara || 94+3 ||

kahite kahite — as I tell; nahi jani nija-para — I do not know mine from another's; ye uthaye taha bali — what rises I say; na karaye dara — without fear

94+3As I tell it, I do not know mine from another's:
whatever comes [to mind], I say without fear.

সর্ব-অবতার-সার চৈতন্য গোসাঞি ।
এহেন করুণানিধি আর হৈতে নাই ॥ ৯৪+৪ ॥

sarba-abatāra-sāra caitanya gosāñi |
ehena karuṇānidhi āra haite nāi || 94+4 ||

sarva-avatara-sara — the essence of all avataras; chaitanya gosani — Chaitanya Gosani; ehena karunanidhi — such a treasury of mercy; ara haite nai — there will never be again

94+4Chaitanya Gosani is the essence of all avataras:
such a treasury of mercy there will never be again.

কৃষ্ণ বহি আর কেহো নাহিক ঈশ্বর ।
সত্য কিবা ত্রেতা আর এ কলি দ্বাপর ॥ ৯৪+৫ ॥

kṛṣṇa bahi āra keho nāhika īśbara |
satya kibā tretā āra e kali dbāpara || 94+5 ||

krishna bahi — except Krishna; ara keho nahika ishvara — there is no other Ishvara; satya kiba treta — in Satya or Treta; ara e kali dvapara — and in Kali and Dvapara

94+5There is no Ishvara but Krishna —
not in Satya, nor Treta, nor Kali, nor Dvapara.

একমাত্র প্রভু সেই, নাম করে ভেদ ।
লোকে বুঝাবারে করে নানামত ভেদ ॥ ৯৪+৬ ॥

ekamātra prabhu sei, nāma kare bheda |
loke bujhābāre kare nānāmata bheda || 94+6 ||

ekamatra prabhu sei — the Lord is one alone; nama kare bheda — [only] the names differ; loke bujhabare — to make people understand; kare nanamata bheda — He shows various distinctions

94+6The Lord is one; only the names differ:
to make people understand, He shows various forms.

যত যত অবতার সেই সব যুগে ।
করুণা-কারণ ছোট বড় বলে লোকে ॥ ৯৪+৭ ॥

yata yata abatāra sei saba yuge |
karuṇā-kāraṇa choṭa baṛa bale loke || 94+7 ||

yata yata avatara — all the avataras; sei saba yuge — in all those ages; karuna-karana — according to [their] mercy; chhota bada bale loke — people call lesser and greater

94+7All the avataras in all those ages
people call lesser and greater according to their mercy.

চৈতন্য গোসাঞি এই করুণাতে বড় ।
তেঞি বলি অবতার-শিরোমণি দঢ় ॥ ৯৪+৮ ॥

caitanya gosāñi ei karuṇāte baṛa |
teñi bali abatāra-śiromaṇi daṛha || 94+8 ||

chaitanya gosani — Chaitanya Gosani; ei karunate bada — is great in this mercy; tenyi bali — therefore I say; avatara-shiromani dadha — firmly, [He is] the crown of avataras

94+8Chaitanya Gosani is great precisely in this mercy —
therefore I firmly say: He is the crown of avataras.

হেন অবতার কেহো না বুঝয়ে লোকে ।
অমৃত ঢাকিয়া যেন রাখে ক্ষুদ্র পোকে ॥ ৯৪+৯ ॥

hena abatāra keho nā bujhaẏe loke |
amṛta ḍhākiẏā yena rākhe kṣudra poke || 94+9 ||

hena avatara — such an avatara; keho na bujhaye loke — people do not recognise; amrita dhakiya yena — as if covering nectar; rakhe kshudra poke — small insects keep it

94+9Such an avatara people do not recognise:
as if small insects had covered the nectar [and hidden it].

হেন অবতার-কথা কহিল অলোক ।
হেন গোরাচাঁদ পহুঁ ভজ ছাড়ি' শোক ॥ ৯৪+১০ ॥

hena abatāra-kathā kahila aloka |
hena gorācāṁda pahuṁ bhaja chāṛi' śoka || 94+10 ||

hena avatara-katha — the account of such an avatara; kahila aloka — I have told (wondrous); hena gorachanda panhu — such a Lord Gorachand; bhaja chhadi shoka — worship, leaving sorrow

94+10I have told of so wondrous a descent:
worship such a Lord, Gorachand, leaving sorrow.

করুণাসাগর প্রভু প্রেমে উনমত ।
ভক্তসঙ্গে বৃন্দাবন-লীলা অবিরত ॥ ৯৪+১১ ॥

karuṇāsāgara prabhu preme unamata |
bhaktasaṅge bṛndābana-līlā abirata || 94+11 ||

karuna-sagara prabhu — the Lord, an ocean of mercy; preme unamata — mad with prema; bhakta-sange — with the devotees; vrindavana-lila avirata — ceaselessly [absorbed] in the lilas of Vrindavana

94+11The Lord, an ocean of mercy, mad with prema,
is ceaselessly [absorbed] with His devotees in the lilas of Vrindavana.

এইমতে মহাপ্রভুর উৎকল-বিহার ।
উৎকল-বিহার-কথা অনেক বিস্তার ॥ ৯৪+১২ ॥

eimate mahāprabhura utkala-bihāra |
utkala-bihāra-kathā aneka bistāra || 94+12 ||

eimate — such were; mahaprabhura utkala-vihara — Mahaprabhu's pastimes in Utkala; utkala-vihara-katha — the account of the Utkala pastimes; aneka vistara — is very extensive

94+12Such were Mahaprabhu's pastimes in Utkala;
the account of the Utkala pastimes is very extensive.

বিস্তারিতে পুস্তক সে হয় ত অনেক ।
সংক্ষেপে কহিল কথা শুন সর্বলোক ॥ ৯৪+১৩ ॥

bistārite pustaka se haẏa ta aneka |
saṃkṣepe kahila kathā śuna sarbaloka || 94+13 ||

vistarite — if told at length; pustaka se haya ta aneka — the book would be very large; sankshepe kahila katha — I have told it briefly; shuna sarvaloka — hear, everyone

94+13If told at length, the book would be enormous;
I have told it briefly — hear, everyone.

হেনকালে মহাপ্রভু কাশীমিশ্র-ঘরে ।
বৃন্দাবন-কথা কহে ব্যথিত অন্তরে ॥ ৯৪+১৪ ॥

henakāle mahāprabhu kāśīmiśra-ghare |
bṛndābana-kathā kahe byathita antare || 94+14 ||

henakale — at that time; mahaprabhu kashimishra-ghare — Mahaprabhu in Kashi Mishra's house; vrindavana-katha kahe — speaks of Vrindavana; vyathita antare — with an aching heart

94+14At that time Mahaprabhu, in Kashi Mishra's house,
speaks of Vrindavana with an aching heart.

নিশ্বাস ছাড়িয়া সে বলিলা মহাপ্রভু ।
এমত ভকত-সঙ্গ নাহি দেখি কভু ॥ ৯৪+১৫ ॥

niśbāsa chāṛiẏā se balilā mahāprabhu |
emata bhakata-saṅga nāhi dekhi kabhu || 94+15 ||

nishvasa chhadiya — sighing; se balila mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu said; emata bhakata-sanga — such company of devotees; nahi dekhi kabhu — I have never seen

94+15Sighing, Mahaprabhu said:
"Never have I seen such a company of devotees."

সম্ভ্রমে উঠিলা জগন্নাথ দেখিবারে ।
ক্রমে ক্রমে উত্তরিলা গিয়া সিংহদ্বারে ॥ ৯৪+১৬ ॥

sambhrame uṭhilā jagannātha dekhibāre |
krame krame uttarilā giẏā siṃhadbāre || 94+16 ||

sambhrame uthila — He rose in haste; jagannatha dekhibare — to see Jagannatha; krame krame — step by step; uttarila giya simha-dvare — He came to the Lion Gate

94+16He rose in haste to see Jagannatha
and step by step came to the Lion Gate.

সঙ্গে নিজজন যত তেমতি চলিল ।
সত্বরে চলিয়া গেল মন্দির-ভিতর ॥ ৯৪+১৭ ॥

saṅge nijajana yata temati calila |
satbare caliẏā gela mandira-bhitara || 94+17 ||

sange nijajana yata — all His companions; temati chalila — went likewise; satvare chaliya gela — He quickly went; mandira-bhitara — inside the temple

94+17All His companions went with Him,
and He quickly went inside the temple.

নিরখে বদন প্রভু, দেখিতে না পায় ।
সেইখানে মনে প্রভু চিন্তিল উপায় ॥ ৯৪+১৮ ॥

nirakhe badana prabhu, dekhite nā pāẏa |
seikhāne mane prabhu cintila upāẏa || 94+18 ||

nirakhe vadana prabhu — the Lord gazes at the face; dekhite na paya — [but] cannot see; seikhane — there; mane prabhu chintila upaya — the Lord thought of a means in His mind

94+18The Lord gazes at [Jagannatha's] face — and cannot see;
then the Lord thought of a means in His mind9.

তখনে দুয়ারে নিজ লাগিল কপাট ।
সত্বরে চলিয়া গেল অন্তরে উচাট ॥ ৯৪+১৯ ॥

takhane duẏāre nija lāgila kapāṭa |
satbare caliẏā gela antare ucāṭa || 94+19 ||

takhane — then; duyare nija lagila kapata — the doors closed of themselves; satvare chaliya gela — He went quickly [within]; antare uchata — with longing in His heart

94+19Then the doors closed of themselves,
and He quickly went [within] with longing in His heart.

আষাঢ় মাসের তিথি সপ্তমী দিবসে ।
নিবেদন করে প্রভু ছাড়িয়া নিশ্বাসে ॥ ৯৪+২০ ॥

āṣāṛha māsera tithi saptamī dibase |
nibedana kare prabhu chāṛiẏā niśbāse || 94+20 ||

ashadha masera tithi — in the month of Ashadha, on the lunar day; saptami divase — the seventh; nivedana kare prabhu — the Lord makes a plea; chhadiya nishvase — with a sigh

94+20In the month of Ashadha, on the seventh lunar day,
the Lord, sighing, makes His plea:

সত্য ত্রেতা দ্বাপর সে কলিযুগ আর ।
বিশেষতঃ কলিযুগে সংকীর্তন সার ॥ ৯৪+২১ ॥

satya tretā dbāpara se kaliyuga āra |
biśeṣataḥ kaliyuge saṃkīrtana sāra || 94+21 ||

satya treta dvapara — Satya, Treta, Dvapara; se kaliyuga ara — and the Kali-yuga; visheshatah kaliyuge — especially in the Kali-yuga; sankirtana sara — sankirtana is the essence

94+21"Satya, Treta, Dvapara and the Kali-yuga —
and especially in the Kali-yuga the essence is sankirtana.

কৃপা কর জগন্নাথ পতিত-পাবন ।
কলিযুগ আইল—এই দেহ ত শরণ ॥ ৯৪+২২ ॥

kṛpā kara jagannātha patita-pābana |
kaliyuga āila—ei deha ta śaraṇa || 94+22 ||

kripa kara jagannatha — have mercy, Jagannatha; patita-pavana — purifier of the fallen; kaliyuga aila — the Kali-yuga has come; ei deha ta sharana — give shelter now

94+22Have mercy, Jagannatha, purifier of the fallen:
the Kali-yuga has come — give shelter now!"

এ বোল বলিয়া সেই ত্রিজগত-রায় ।
বাহু ভিড়ি' আলিঙ্গন তুলিল হিয়ায় ॥ ৯৪+২৩ ॥

e bola baliẏā sei trijagata-rāẏa |
bāhu bhiṛi' āliṅgana tulila hiẏāẏa || 94+23 ||

e bola baliya — saying this; sei trijagata-raya — that Lord of the three worlds; bahu bhidi — clasping with His arms; alingana tulila hiyaya — took [Him] in an embrace to His heart

94+23Saying this, that Lord of the three worlds
clasped [Him] in His arms, pressing Him to His heart.

তৃতীয় প্রহর বেলা রবিবার দিনে ।
জগন্নাথে লীন প্রভু হইলা আপনে ॥ ৯৪+২৪ ॥

tṛtīẏa prahara belā rabibāra dine |
jagannāthe līna prabhu hailā āpane || 94+24 ||

tritiya prahara bela — in the third prahara of the day; ravibara dine — on a Sunday; jagannathe lina — merged into Jagannatha; prabhu haila apane — the Lord Himself became

94+24In the third prahara of the day, on a Sunday,
the Lord Himself entered into Jagannatha10.

গুঞ্জাবাড়ীতে ছিল পাণ্ডা যে ব্রাহ্মণ ।
কি কি বলি' সত্বরে সে আইল তখন ॥ ৯৪+২৫ ॥

guñjābāṛīte chila pāṇḍā ye brāhmaṇa |
ki ki bali' satbare se āila takhana || 94+25 ||

gunjabadite chhila — in the Gunjabadi there was; panda ye brahmana — a brahmana panda; ki ki bali — crying "what, what?"; satvare se aila takhana — he came quickly then

94+25A brahmana panda who was in the Gunjabadi,
crying "What, what?", came hurrying at once11.

বিপ্রে দেখি' ভক্ত কহে—শুনহ পড়িছা ।
ঘুচাও কপাট, প্রভু দেখি বড় ইচ্ছা ॥ ৯৪+২৬ ॥

bipre dekhi' bhakta kahe—śunaha paṛichā |
ghucāo kapāṭa, prabhu dekhi baṛa icchā || 94+26 ||

vipre dekhi — seeing the brahmana; bhakta kahe — the devotees say; shunaha padichha — listen, padichha; ghuchao kapata — open the doors; prabhu dekhi bada ichchha — we long to see the Lord

94+26Seeing the brahmana, the devotees say: "Listen, padichha,
open the doors — we long to see the Lord!"

ভক্ত-আর্তি দেখি' পড়িছা কহয়ে কথন ।
গুঞ্জাবাড়ীর মধ্যে প্রভুর হৈল অদর্শন ॥ ৯৪+২৭ ॥

bhakta-ārti dekhi' paṛichā kahaẏe kathana |
guñjābāṛīra madhye prabhura haila adarśana || 94+27 ||

bhakta-arti dekhi — seeing the devotees' distress; padichha kahaye kathana — the padichha speaks; gunjabadira madhye — within the Gunjabadi; prabhura haila adarshana — the Lord disappeared from sight

94+27Seeing the devotees' distress, the padichha says:
"In the Gunjabadi the Lord disappeared from sight.

সাক্ষাতে দেখিল গৌর প্রভুর মিলন ।
নিশ্চয় করিয়া কহি শুন সর্বজন ॥ ৯৪+২৮ ॥

sākṣāte dekhila gaura prabhura milana |
niścaẏa kariẏā kahi śuna sarbajana || 94+28 ||

sakshate dekhila — I saw with my own eyes; gaura prabhura milana — the union of Gaura with the Lord [Jagannatha]; nishchaya kariya kahi — I say for certain; shuna sarvajana — hear, everyone

94+28With my own eyes I saw Gaura unite with the Lord [Jagannatha] —
I say it for certain; hear, everyone."

এ বোল শুনিয়া ভক্ত করে হাহাকার ।
শ্রীমুখ-চন্দ্রিমা প্রভুর না দেখিব আর ॥ ৯৪+২৯ ॥

e bola śuniẏā bhakta kare hāhākāra |
śrīmukha-candrimā prabhura nā dekhiba āra || 94+29 ||

e bola shuniya — hearing this; bhakta kare hahakara — the devotees cried out in grief; sri-mukha-chandrima prabhura — the moonlike face of the Lord; na dekhiba ara — we shall see no more

94+29Hearing this, the devotees cried out in grief:
"We shall see the Lord's moonlike face no more!"

শ্রীবাস পণ্ডিত আর দত্ত যে মুকুন্দ ।
গৌরীদাস বাসুদত্ত আর শ্রীগোবিন্দ ॥ ৯৪+৩০ ॥

śrībāsa paṇḍita āra datta ye mukunda |
gaurīdāsa bāsudatta āra śrīgobinda || 94+30 ||

srivasa pandita — Srivasa Pandita; ara datta ye mukunda — and Mukunda Datta; gauridasa vasudatta — Gauridasa, Vasu Datta; ara sri-govinda — and Sri Govinda

94+30Srivasa Pandita and Mukunda Datta,
Gauridasa, Vasu Datta and Sri Govinda,

কাশীমিশ্র সনাতন আর হরিদাস ।
উৎকলের সবে কান্দে ছাড়িয়া নিশ্বাস ॥ ৯৪+৩১ ॥

kāśīmiśra sanātana āra haridāsa |
utkalera sabe kānde chāṛiẏā niśbāsa || 94+31 ||

kashimishra sanatana — Kashi Mishra, Sanatana; ara haridasa — and Haridasa; utkalera sabe — all the people of Utkala; kande chhadiya nishvasa — weep, sighing deeply

94+31Kashi Mishra, Sanatana and Haridasa —
all the people of Utkala weep, sighing deeply12.

শ্রীপ্রতাপরুদ্র রাজা শুনিল শ্রবণে ।
পরিবার-সহ রাজা হরিল চেতনে ॥ ৯৪+৩২ ॥

śrīpratāparudra rājā śunila śrabaṇe |
paribāra-saha rājā harila cetane || 94+32 ||

sri-prataparudra raja — King Sri Prataparudra; shunila shravane — heard with his own ears; parivara-saha raja — the king with his family; harila chetane — lost consciousness

94+32King Sri Prataparudra heard [the news]
and together with his family lost consciousness.

সার্বভৌম ভট্টাচার্য তনুজ-সহায় ।
প্রভু প্রভু ডাকে, বলে—শুন গৌররায় ॥ ৯৪+৩৩ ॥

sārbabhauma bhaṭṭācārya tanuja-sahāẏa |
prabhu prabhu ḍāke, bale—śuna gaurarāẏa || 94+33 ||

sarvabhauma bhattacharya — Sarvabhauma Bhattacharya; tanuja-sahaya — together with his son; prabhu prabhu dake — calls "Lord, Lord!"; bale shuna gauraraya — says "Hear, Gauraraya!"

94+33Sarvabhauma Bhattacharya, together with his son,
calls: "Lord, Lord! Hear us, Gauraraya!"

অনেক রোদন কৈল সব ভক্তগণ ।
ইহা বা লিখিব কত মো অধম জন ॥ ৯৪+৩৪ ॥

aneka rodana kaila saba bhaktagaṇa |
ihā bā likhiba kata mo adhama jana || 94+34 ||

aneka rodana kaila — wept much; saba bhaktagana — all the devotees; iha va likhiba kata — how much of this can I write; mo adhama jana — I, a low person

94+34All the devotees wept bitterly —
how much of this can I, a low person, write?

অশেষ প্রভুর গুণ—গণনা হয় বিস্তার ।
এবে না দেখিয়া মোর হৈল অন্ধকার ॥ ৯৪+৩৫ ॥

aśeṣa prabhura guṇa—gaṇanā haẏa bistāra |
ebe nā dekhiẏā mora haila andhakāra || 94+35 ||

ashesha prabhura guna — the Lord's qualities are endless; ganana haya vistara — their counting is vast; ebe na dekhiya — now, not seeing [Him]; mora haila andhakara — darkness has come over me

94+35The Lord's qualities are endless — they cannot be counted;
now that I do not see Him, darkness has come over me.

মিনতি করিয়া বলি শুন সব জন ।
দিবানিশি ভজ ভাই গৌরাঙ্গ-চরণ ॥ ৯৪+৩৬ ॥

minati kariẏā bali śuna saba jana |
dibāniśi bhaja bhāi gaurāṅga-caraṇa || 94+36 ||

minati kariya bali — I say imploringly; shuna saba jana — hear, all; divanishi bhaja bhai — day and night worship, brothers; gauranga-charana — the feet of Gauranga

94+36I say imploringly: hear, all,
day and night worship, brothers, the feet of Gauranga.

নির্মল হইয়া সভে শুন গোরাগুণ ।
ভবব্যাধি নাশিবারে এই সে কারণ ॥ ৯৪+৩৭ ॥

nirmala haiẏā sabhe śuna gorāguṇa |
bhababyādhi nāśibāre ei se kāraṇa || 94+37 ||

nirmala haiya — becoming pure; sabhe shuna goraguna — all hear Gora's glories; bhava-vyadhi nashibare — to destroy the disease of worldly existence; ei se karana — this is the means

94+37Becoming pure, all hear Gora's glories:
this is the means to destroy the disease of worldly existence.

এত শোকে বিলপন করয়ে লোচন ।
শেষখণ্ড সায় হৈল প্রভুর কীর্তন ॥ ৯৪+৩৮ ॥

eta śoke bilapana karaẏe locana |
śeṣakhaṇḍa sāẏa haila prabhura kīrtana || 94+38 ||

eta shoke — in such grief; vilapana karaye lochana — Lochana laments; shesha-khanda saya haila — the Shesha-khanda is concluded; prabhura kirtana — of the Lord's glorification

94+38In such grief Lochana laments:
the Shesha-khanda, the glorification of the Lord, is concluded.

Lochana Dasa's Word about Himself

গৃহ-ব্যবহার-কথা শুন সর্বজন ।
হেনই সময়ে করো শ্রীহরি-স্মরণ ॥ ৯৪+৩৯ ॥

gṛha-byabahāra-kathā śuna sarbajana |
henai samaẏe karo śrīhari-smaraṇa || 94+39 ||

griha-vyavahara-katha — the account of my household; shuna sarvajana — hear, everyone; henai samaye — at this time; karo sri-hari-smarana — remember Sri Hari

94+39Hear, everyone, about my home and family,
and at the same time remember Sri Hari13.

সভাকারে করোঁ মুঞি এই নিবেদন ।
সত্য করি' জানিহ শ্রীবৈষ্ণব-চরণ ॥ ৯৪+৪০ ॥

sabhākāre karoṁ muñi ei nibedana |
satya kari' jāniha śrībaiṣṇaba-caraṇa || 94+40 ||

sabhakare karon munyi — to all I make; ei nivedana — this request; satya kari janiha — know as true; sri-vaishnava-charana — the feet of the Vaishnavas

94+40To all I make one request:
know as true the feet of the Vaishnavas.

গৌরপদ-কমলে মো করিয়ে প্রণতি ।
তিলেক করুণা-দিঠে কর অবগতি ॥ ৯৪+৪১ ॥

gaurapada-kamale mo kariẏe praṇati |
tileka karuṇā-diṭhe kara abagati || 94+41 ||

gaura-pada-kamale — to Gaura's lotus feet; mo kariye pranati — I bow; tileka karuna-dithe — for a moment with a merciful glance; kara avagati — regard [me]

94+41I bow to Gaura's lotus feet:
for a moment regard [me] with a merciful glance.

বৈষ্ণব-প্রসাদে কিছু যে জানি প্রকাশ ।
প্রাণের ঠাকুর মোর নরহরি দাস ॥ ৯৪+৪২ ॥

baiṣṇaba-prasāde kichu ye jāni prakāśa |
prāṇera ṭhākura mora narahari dāsa || 94+42 ||

vaishnava-prasade — by the Vaishnavas' grace; kichhu ye jani prakasha — the little I know and set forth; pranera thakura mora — the Thakura of my life; narahari dasa — Narahari Dasa

94+42The little I know and set forth is by the Vaishnavas' grace;
the Thakura of my life is Narahari Dasa.

তাঁর পদ-প্রসাদে এ পথের প্রতি আশ ।
গোরাগুণ কহিবারে কৈলুঁ অভিলাষ ॥ ৯৪+৪৩ ॥

tāṁra pada-prasāde e pathera prati āśa |
gorāguṇa kahibāre kailuṁ abhilāṣa || 94+43 ||

tanra pada-prasade — by the grace of his feet; e pathera prati asha — hope in this path; goraguna kahibare — to tell Gora's glories; kailun abhilasha — I conceived the desire

94+43By the grace of his feet I gained hope in this path
and conceived the desire to tell Gora's glories.

শ্রীমুরারি গুপ্ত বেজা প্রভুর অন্তরীণ ।
সকল জানয়ে সেই ভকত প্রবীণ ॥ ৯৪+৪৪ ॥

śrīmurāri gupta bejā prabhura antarīṇa |
sakala jānaẏe sei bhakata prabīṇa || 94+44 ||

sri-murari gupta beja — Sri Murari Gupta the vaidya; prabhura antarina — the Lord's intimate; sakala janaye — knows everything; sei bhakata pravina — that seasoned devotee

94+44Sri Murari Gupta the vaidya, the Lord's intimate,
knows everything — that seasoned devotee.

লোক নিস্তারিতে কৈল চৈতন্য-চরিত্র ।
তাঁহার প্রসাদে হৈল সংসার পবিত্র ॥ ৯৪+৪৫ ॥

loka nistārite kaila caitanya-caritra |
tāṁhāra prasāde haila saṃsāra pabitra || 94+45 ||

loka nistarite — to deliver the people; kaila chaitanya-charitra — he composed the life of Chaitanya; tanhara prasade — by his grace; haila samsara pavitra — the world was purified

94+45To deliver the people he composed the life of Chaitanya;
by his grace the world was purified.

শ্লোকবন্ধে কৈল গৌরগুণের কবিত্ব ।
তাহাই হইল এবে সকলের সূত্র ॥ ৯৪+৪৬ ॥

ślokabandhe kaila gauraguṇera kabitba |
tāhāi haila ebe sakalera sūtra || 94+46 ||

shloka-bandhe — in verses; kaila gaura-gunera kavitva — he composed a poem on Gaura's glories; tahai haila ebe — that has now become; sakalera sutra — the thread (basis) for all

94+46He composed in verses a poem on Gaura's glories —
it has now become the basis for all14.

শুনিয়া মাধুরী-লোভে চিত উতরোল ।
নিজ দোষ না দেখিলুঁ, মন হৈল ভোল ॥ ৯৪+৪৭ ॥

śuniẏā mādhurī-lobhe cita utarola |
nija doṣa nā dekhiluṁ, mana haila bhola || 94+47 ||

shuniya — hearing it; madhuri-lobhe — in greed for its sweetness; chita utarola — my heart was stirred; nija dosha na dekhilun — I did not look at my own faults; mana haila bhola — my mind forgot itself

94+47Hearing it, in greed for its sweetness my heart was stirred:
I did not look at my own faults — my mind forgot itself.

পাঁচালী-প্রবন্ধে আমি রচিল এখন ।
দোষ না লইবে কেহো, মো অতি অধম ॥ ৯৪+৪৮ ॥

pāṁcālī-prabandhe āmi racila ekhana |
doṣa nā laibe keho, mo ati adhama || 94+48 ||

panchali-prabandhe — in panchali form; ami rachila ekhana — I have now composed; dosha na laibe keho — let no one take offence; mo ati adhama — I am most low

94+48Now I have composed [this account] in panchali form —
let no one judge harshly: I am most low.

অধিকারী নাহি তবু করিলুঁ সাহস ।
বৈষ্ণব-করুণা দেখি' মনের ভরস ॥ ৯৪+৪৯ ॥

adhikārī nāhi tabu kariluṁ sāhasa |
baiṣṇaba-karuṇā dekhi' manera bharasa || 94+49 ||

adhikari nahi — I am not qualified; tabu karilun sahasa — yet I dared; vaishnava-karuna dekhi — seeing the Vaishnavas' mercy; manera bharasa — my heart's confidence

94+49I am not qualified, and yet I dared:
seeing the Vaishnavas' mercy, I took heart.

চারিখণ্ড পুঁথি হৈল বৈষ্ণব-কৃপায় ।
সমাধা করিতে ব্যথা লাগয়ে হিয়ায় ॥ ৯৪+৫০ ॥

cārikhaṇḍa puṁthi haila baiṣṇaba-kṛpāẏa |
samādhā karite byathā lāgaẏe hiẏāẏa || 94+50 ||

chari-khanda punthi haila — the book in four parts came to be; vaishnava-kripaya — by the Vaishnavas' mercy; samadha karite — in finishing it; vyatha lagaye hiyaya — my heart aches

94+50By the Vaishnavas' mercy the book in four parts came to be;
in finishing it, my heart aches.

সূত্রখণ্ডে আদ্য কথা অমৃতের খণ্ড ।
জন্মাদি-রহস্য-কথা কহিল আদ্যখণ্ড ॥ ৯৪+৫১ ॥

sūtrakhaṇḍe ādya kathā amṛtera khaṇḍa |
janmādi-rahasya-kathā kahila ādyakhaṇḍa || 94+51 ||

sutra-khande adya katha — in the Sutra-khanda the opening account; amritera khanda — a portion of nectar; janmadi-rahasya-katha — the secrets of the birth and the rest; kahila adya-khanda — the Adi-khanda told

94+51In the Sutra-khanda is the opening account, a portion of nectar;
the secrets of the birth and the rest the Adi-khanda told.

মধ্যখণ্ড-কথা তাই করুণার ঘর ।
শেষখণ্ড-কথা সে তিন খণ্ডের পর ॥ ৯৪+৫২ ॥

madhyakhaṇḍa-kathā tāi karuṇāra ghara |
śeṣakhaṇḍa-kathā se tina khaṇḍera para || 94+52 ||

madhya-khanda-katha — the account of the Madhya-khanda; tai karunara ghara — is an abode of mercy; shesha-khanda-katha — the account of the Shesha-khanda; se tina khandera para — after the three parts

94+52The account of the Madhya-khanda is an abode of mercy;
the account of the Shesha-khanda comes after the three parts.

চারিখণ্ড-কথা হৈল বৈষ্ণব-কৃপায় ।
সমাধা করিতে ব্যথা লাগয়ে হিয়ায় ॥ ৯৪+৫৩ ॥

cārikhaṇḍa-kathā haila baiṣṇaba-kṛpāẏa |
samādhā karite byathā lāgaẏe hiẏāẏa || 94+53 ||

chari-khanda-katha haila — the account in four parts came to be; vaishnava-kripaya — by the Vaishnavas' mercy; samadha karite — in finishing; vyatha lagaye hiyaya — my heart aches

94+53By the Vaishnavas' mercy the account in four parts came to be;
in finishing it, my heart aches.

গৌরগুণ-কথা এই অমৃত-সমুদ্র ।
কহিতে না পারে প্রভু প্রজাপতি রুদ্র ॥ ৯৪+৫৪ ॥

gauraguṇa-kathā ei amṛta-samudra |
kahite nā pāre prabhu prajāpati rudra || 94+54 ||

gaura-guna-katha ei — this account of Gaura's glories; amrita-samudra — is an ocean of nectar; kahite na pare — cannot tell it; prabhu prajapati rudra — even the lords Prajapati and Rudra

94+54This account of Gaura's glories is an ocean of nectar:
even the lords Prajapati and Rudra cannot tell it.

আমি কি কহিব গুণ, কি জানি কতেক ।
বৈষ্ণব-কৃপার বলে বলিল যতেক ॥ ৯৪+৫৫ ॥

āmi ki kahiba guṇa, ki jāni kateka |
baiṣṇaba-kṛpāra bale balila yateka || 94+55 ||

ami ki kahiba guna — what can I tell of [His] glories; ki jani kateka — how much do I know; vaishnava-kripara bale — by the strength of the Vaishnavas' mercy; balila yateka — I have said whatever I said

94+55What can I tell of His glories, how much do I know?
All that I have said is by the strength of the Vaishnavas' mercy.

করজোড় করি' বলোঁ কাতর-বয়ানে ।
আত্মনিবেদিনু মুঞি বৈষ্ণব-চরণে ॥ ৯৪+৫৬ ॥

karajoṛa kari' baloṁ kātara-baẏāne |
ātmanibedinu muñi baiṣṇaba-caraṇe || 94+56 ||

karajoda kari — with joined palms; balon katara-bayane — I speak imploringly; atma-nivedinu munyi — I have offered myself; vaishnava-charane — at the feet of the Vaishnavas

94+56With joined palms I speak imploringly:
I have offered myself at the feet of the Vaishnavas.

মো অধিক অধম নাহিক মহী-মাঝ ।
বৈষ্ণব-কৃপার বলে সিদ্ধ হৈল কাজ ॥ ৯৪+৫৭ ॥

mo adhika adhama nāhika mahī-mājha |
baiṣṇaba-kṛpāra bale siddha haila kāja || 94+57 ||

mo adhika adhama — lower than I; nahika mahi-majha — there is none on earth; vaishnava-kripara bale — by the strength of the Vaishnavas' mercy; siddha haila kaja — the work is accomplished

94+57There is no one on earth lower than I —
by the strength of the Vaishnavas' mercy the work is accomplished.

চৈতন্যচরিত-কথা কে কহিতে জানে ।
সম্বরিতে নারি, কিছু কহিনু বদনে ॥ ৯৪+৫৮ ॥

caitanyacarita-kathā ke kahite jāne |
sambarite nāri, kichu kahinu badane || 94+58 ||

chaitanya-charita-katha — the story of Chaitanya; ke kahite jane — who knows how to tell; samvarite nari — unable to restrain myself; kichhu kahinu vadane — I have spoken a little

94+58Who knows how to tell the story of Chaitanya's life?
Unable to restrain myself, I have spoken a little.

চারিখণ্ড-কথা সায় করিল প্রকাশ ।
বৈদ্যকুলে জন্ম মোর, কোগ্রামে নিবাস ॥ ৯৪+৫৯ ॥

cārikhaṇḍa-kathā sāẏa karila prakāśa |
baidyakule janma mora, kogrāme nibāsa || 94+59 ||

chari-khanda-katha — the account in four parts; saya karila prakasha — I have completed and made known; vaidya-kule janma mora — I was born in the vaidya caste; ko-grame nivasa — I live in Kogram

94+59Having completed the account in four parts, I have made it known.
I was born in the vaidya caste and live in Kogram.

মাতা মোর পুণ্যবতী সদানন্দী নাম ।
যাঁহার উদরে জন্মি' করি কৃষ্ণকাম ॥ ৯৪+৬০ ॥

mātā mora puṇyabatī sadānandī nāma |
yāṁhāra udare janmi' kari kṛṣṇakāma || 94+60 ||

mata mora punyavati — my pious mother; sadanandi nama — named Sadanandi; yanhara udare janmi — born from whose womb; kari krishna-kama — I long for Krishna

94+60My pious mother is named Sadanandi:
born from her womb, I long for Krishna.

কমলাকর দাস মোর পিতা জন্মদাতা ।
যাঁহার প্রসাদে কহি গোরাগুণগাথা ॥ ৯৪+৬১ ॥

kamalākara dāsa mora pitā janmadātā |
yāṁhāra prasāde kahi gorāguṇagāthā || 94+61 ||

kamalakara dasa — Kamalakara Dasa; mora pita janmadata — my father who gave me birth; yanhara prasade — by whose grace; kahi goraguna-gatha — I tell the tale of Gora's glories

94+61My father who gave me birth is Kamalakara Dasa:
by his grace I tell the tale of Gora's glories.

মাতৃকুল পিতৃকুল বৈসে এক গ্রামে ।
ধন্য মাতামহী সে অভয়া দাসী নামে ॥ ৯৪+৬২ ॥

mātṛkula pitṛkula baise eka grāme |
dhanya mātāmahī se abhaẏā dāsī nāme || 94+62 ||

matrikula pitrikula — the mother's family and the father's family; baise eka grame — live in one village; dhanya matamahi — blessed is my grandmother; se abhaya dasi name — named Abhaya Dasi

94+62My mother's family and my father's family live in one village;
blessed is my grandmother, named Abhaya Dasi.

মাতামহের নাম শ্রীপুরুষোত্তম গুপ্ত ।
নানাতীর্থপূত তেঁহ, তপস্যায় তৃপ্ত ॥ ৯৪+৬৩ ॥

mātāmahera nāma śrīpuruṣottama gupta |
nānātīrthapūta teṁha, tapasyāẏa tṛpta || 94+63 ||

matamahera nama — the name of my maternal grandfather; sri-purushottama gupta — Sri Purushottama Gupta; nana-tirtha-puta tenha — he was purified by many tirthas; tapasyaya tripta — content in austerity

94+63The name of my maternal grandfather is Sri Purushottama Gupta:
he was purified by many tirthas and content in austerity.

মাতৃকুলে পিতৃকুলে আমি মাত্র পুত্র ।
সহোদর নাহি, নাহি মাতামহের সূত্র ॥ ৯৪+৬৪ ॥

mātṛkule pitṛkule āmi mātra putra |
sahodara nāhi, nāhi mātāmahera sūtra || 94+64 ||

matrikule pitrikule — in the mother's and father's families; ami matra putra — I am the only son; sahodara nahi — there are no brothers; nahi matamahera sutra — no [other] line of my grandfather

94+64In my mother's family and my father's I am the only son:
I have no brothers, and my grandfather has no [other] line.

যথা তথা যাই, সে দুলালি' করে মোরে ।
দুলাল লাগিয়া কেহো পড়াইতে নারে ॥ ৯৪+৬৫ ॥

yathā tathā yāi, se dulāli' kare more |
dulāla lāgiẏā keho paṛāite nāre || 94+65 ||

yatha tatha yai — wherever I went; se dulali kare more — they petted me; dulala lagiya — because I was a darling; keho padaite nare — no one could teach me

94+65Wherever I went, they petted me:
because I was a spoiled darling, no one could teach me.

মারিয়া ধরিয়া মোরে শিখাইল আখর ।
ধন্য পুরুষোত্তম গুপ্ত, চরিত্র তাঁহার ॥ ৯৪+৬৬ ॥

māriẏā dhariẏā more śikhāila ākhara |
dhanya puruṣottama gupta, caritra tāṁhāra || 94+66 ||

mariya dhariya — with beating and restraint; more shikhaila akhara — he taught me letters; dhanya purushottama gupta — blessed is Purushottama Gupta; charitra tanhara — and his character

94+66[But he,] by beating and strictness, taught me letters —
blessed is Purushottama Gupta and his character!

তাঁহার চরণে মুঞি করোঁ নমস্কার ।
চৈতন্যচরিত লিখি প্রসাদে যাঁহার ॥ ৯৪+৬৭ ॥

tāṁhāra caraṇe muñi karoṁ namaskāra |
caitanyacarita likhi prasāde yāṁhāra || 94+67 ||

tanhara charane — at his feet; munyi karon namaskara — I bow; chaitanya-charita likhi — I write the life of Chaitanya; prasade yanhara — by whose grace

94+67I bow at his feet:
by his grace I write the life of Chaitanya.

মাতৃকুল পিতৃকুল কহিল মো কথা ।
নরহরি দাস মোর প্রেমভক্তি-দাতা ॥ ৯৪+৬৮ ॥

mātṛkula pitṛkula kahila mo kathā |
narahari dāsa mora premabhakti-dātā || 94+68 ||

matrikula pitrikula — of my mother's and father's families; kahila mo katha — I have told; narahari dasa — Narahari Dasa; mora prema-bhakti-data — is the giver of prema-bhakti to me

94+68I have told of my mother's and my father's families.
Narahari Dasa is the giver of prema-bhakti to me.

তাঁহার প্রসাদে যেবা করিল প্রকাশ ।
পুস্তক করিল সায় এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৯৪+৬৯ ॥

tāṁhāra prasāde yebā karila prakāśa |
pustaka karila sāẏa e locanadāsa || 94+69 ||

tanhara prasade — by his grace; yeba karila prakasha — what [I] have set forth; pustaka karila saya — has completed the book; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

94+69By his grace is all that I have set forth:
[thus] this Lochana Dasa has completed the book.

Thus ends the Shesha-khanda of the "Sri Chaitanya-mangala," composed by Sri Lochana Dasa Thakura. The "Sri Chaitanya-mangala" is complete15.

Notes

  1. Vv. 1–94 — cf. Murari 4.21 (the poor brahmana from Dravida and Vibhishana at Gaura's feet). Vibhishana is Ravana's brother, a devotee of Rama, by tradition immortal (chiranjivi); in Puri it is said that he comes to see Jagannatha.
  2. The brahmana threatens to die at the Deity's door, so that the sin of killing a brahmana would fall on the Lord Himself. Lochana Dasa himself below (vv. 57–61), through the Lord's words, censures this disposition — blaming the Lord for the fruits of one's own karma.
  3. V. 29+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; it is absent in the 1903 edition.
  4. A finger to the nose is a gesture of astonishment: Vibhishana is surprised that the brahmana is still following him. At the gate Govinda sees "two young brahmanas" (v. 50): Vibhishana appears in the guise of a brahmana.
  5. Cf. the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 22): even when He is worshipped for other desires, Krishna grants the petitioner His feet, and in time that person gives up other desires.
  6. V. 86 is spoken by Puri Gosani (Paramananda Puri), who tells how he ventured to ask.
  7. Here the text in Bhaktisiddhanta's edition ends; what follows is a chapter found only in the 1983 edition (in the 1903 edition, in a footnote).

The chapter is translated from Haridasa Shastri's edition (1983), where it stands as chapter 4 of the Shesha-khanda (we have transcribed its text from Devanagari into Bengali script, see bn/52). The 1903 edition gives it not in the main text but in a footnote after v. 94, with the editor's remarks on the sources, with variant readings and several additional lines (these, being absent in the 1983 edition, we do not translate). The numbering continues that of the section: 94+1, 94+2…
  9. The sense of the couplet is unclear: apparently the Lord, in separation, cannot be satisfied with seeing Jagannatha and resolves to unite with Him for ever.
  10. Lochana Dasa writes that the Lord "entered into Jagannatha" (literally, "became lina," "merged"). In the Gaudiya Vaishnava understanding (Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati), the Lord's departure is antardhana-lila: He only withdrew from mundane sight, just as He appeared by His own will; His body is sach-chid-ananda, not material, and there is no death for Him. The "merging" here is not the impersonal dissolution of a jiva in Brahman: the Lord re-enters His own form — the Deity of Jagannatha, non-different from Him (cf. en/45, note 15, on the Daru-brahman and en/51, v. 85). Other traditions tell of the departure differently: Jayananda (Chaitanya-mangala) speaks of a wound to the foot from a brick during the Ratha-yatra; according to another tradition the Lord disappeared in the temple of Tota-Gopinatha; the Chaitanya-charitamrita gives no account of the Lord's departure. The traditional date is 1533 (Shaka 1455).
  11. The Gunjabadi is apparently a room or courtyard in the Jagannatha temple; the exact meaning is unclear. The padichha is the temple superintendent (cf. en/51, v. 75).
  12. The list is poetic: according to the Chaitanya-charitamrita, Haridasa Thakura departed before the Lord (Antya 11), and Sanatana Gosvami lived in Vrindavana. Gauridasa is apparently Gauridasa Pandita of Ambika (Kalna); Govinda is the Lord's servant (or Govinda Ghosha).

Vv. 94+39 — 94+69 are Lochana Dasa's closing word; they are found only in the 1983 edition (in the 1903 edition, in the same footnote, with variant readings and with additional lines on Narahari Sarakara, Raghunandana and others that are absent in the 1983 edition). Lochana Dasa was a vaidya and lived in Kogram (now in Purba Bardhaman district, West Bengal); his mother was Sadanandi, his father Kamalakara Dasa; his maternal grandfather Purushottama Gupta, his grandmother Abhaya Dasi; his guru Narahari Sarakara Thakura of Shrikhanda.
